composition_variation: Paint Zenitsu Agatsuma taking a peaceful seated rest on a golden meadow slope. His yellow geometric haori is fully closed over comfortable clothes, and his hands loosely hold a small round lunch parcel. Use luminous wheat-gold and powder-blue colors, fine grass silhouettes, airy clouds, and a soft storybook lens. Give him a relaxed sleepy smile instead of a startled expression. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
